name: Ayatsurareru!? Watashi no Shitai wa Dareka no Omocha
original_name: アヤツラレル！？私の肢体は誰かのオモチャ
source:
Mysterious things happen in this town... Supposedly, the victims are all woman.
Their bodies move out of their control and do things that they do not wish to do...
There have been no reported cases of death so the case hasn't been taken too seriously.
But... for the victims in question it may be an experience even worse than death...

An utterly humiliating and life destroying... erotic experience.

Rumor has it, that a person with special powers is going around and granting the desires of men.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这个小镇发生了神秘的事情……据说，受害者都是女性。
他们的身体失去了控制，做出了他们不想做的事情……
目前还没有死亡病例报告，因此此案并未受到太重视。
但是……对于受害者来说，这可能是比死亡更糟糕的经历……

一次完全羞辱和毁灭生命的……色情经历。

有传言说，有一个拥有特殊能力的人正在四处走动，满足人们的愿望。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196593.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
